glosses: horizon (line where the sky appears to meet the earth; (figurative) range of someone’s thinking or insight)

examples.text: Der Mond stand über dem Horizont.
examples.en: The moon was above the horizon.

examples.text: Das Problem geht über meinen Horizont.
examples.en: The problem is beyond the scope of my understanding.
A ship appeared on the horizon.

examples.text: Ich sah den Mond über dem Horizont.
examples.en: I saw the moon above the horizon.
The sun is sinking below the horizon.
